KADUWELA MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
(Chapter 267) Entertainment Tax Ordinance
IMPOSING ENTERTAINMENT TAX

IT is hereby notified the public that I, Isuru Devapriya, Chief Minister and Minister of Finance & Planning, LocalGovernments, Economic Development, Electricity & Power, Environment Affairs, Water Supply & Drainage and TourismAffairs of Western Province Provincial Council has approved the following resolution passed under ResolutionNo. 05(1)(i)(w)/02/uq/0288 at the General Meeting held on 03rd August, 2018 by the Kaduwela Municipal Council undervirtue of the powers in me by Sub Section (2) Section 2 of (Chapter 267) Entertainment Tax Ordinance read with Paragraph(a) Sub Section (1) Section 2 of Provincial Council (Consequentional Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 1989.

ISURU DEVAPRIYA,Chief Minister and Minister of Finance & Planning,Local Governments, Economic Development, Electricity & Power,Environment Affairs, Water Supply & Drainage and Tourism Affairs,Western Province Provincial Council.
27th February, 2019.
